meta.appDescription: Browser-based planner for household cash flow, rentals, and long-range savings curves—with scenario compare. Google sign-in is required to access the tool.

siteFooter.tagline: Budget and cash-flow tool: local entry, monthly calendar, projections and scenario comparison.
siteFooter.privacyLocal: Once signed in with Google, your simulator scenarios may be stored on our servers depending on deployment settings.
siteFooter.cookiesNote: Anonymous audience metrics may be used to improve the site; we do not sell advertising profiles.

navigation.themeCycle: Theme: tap to cycle system, light, then dark

salaries.overwriteMonthMessage: A payslip already exists for {{period}}. Saving will overwrite salary and all bonuses (included and non-included).
salaries.saisieLead: One payslip per month (unique year + month). CSV import supported (comma or semicolon).
salaries.importError: Import failed (check your CSV column headers).
salaries.extractOk: Fields prefilled — check amounts before saving.
salaries.extractErrorDisabled: AI extraction is not configured on this server.
salaries.extractErrorApi: Analysis service unavailable. Try again later.
salaries.extractErrorNotPayslip: This file does not appear to be a payslip. Check the document and try again.
salaries.extractPendingPrimes: {{bonuses}} included bonus(es) and {{nonIncluded}} non-included line(s) will be added on save.
salaries.primesDialogLead: Amounts included in payslip gross and itemized bonus lines.
salaries.primesNonInclusesDialogLead: Lines added to gross for the summary (not on the payslip). The table total bonuses column includes included bonuses too.
salaries.saveMonthBeforeBonus: Save the month first, then reopen to add bonuses.
salaries.recapLead: Monthly averages per year from recorded payslips and entered bonuses (net basis and meal vouchers).
salaries.recapYearlyIncomeLead: Each column is the sum of monthly amounts (meal vouchers included) divided by the number of payslips that year. “Excl. income tax” = net pay + PAYE withholding (before PAYE). “Net” = after PAYE.
salaries.recapAvgHorsImpotsSansPrimes: Excl. income tax — payslip (net + PAYE + vouchers)
salaries.recapAvgHorsImpotsAvecPrimes: Excl. income tax — with bonuses and vouchers
salaries.recapTotalNetHorsImpots: Total net excl. income tax (net pay + meal vouchers)
salaries.evolutionLead: Monthly averages per year and change vs previous year (on actual net pay).
salaries.chartTitle: Net pay vs. package excl. income tax
salaries.chartLead: Month-by-month curves across all recorded payslips (amounts in EUR).
salaries.chartLeadYear: Monthly averages per year: annual total (payslip net + net-basis bonuses + meal vouchers) ÷ number of payslips recorded for that year.
salaries.chartLeadMonth: Payslip net plus net-basis bonuses; total excl. income tax includes meal vouchers.
salaries.chartTotalNetHorsImpotsMonthlyAvg: Excl. income tax with bonuses and vouchers (average)
salaries.employersLead: Define employers and employment periods (end date is optional if the role is still current); averages use payslips linked to each employer.
salaries.confirmDeleteEmployer: Delete this employer and its periods?
salaries.periodEndHint: If you leave the end month empty, the period is treated as ongoing today.
salaries.periodOngoingToggle: Still in this role (no end month)
salaries.periodEndBeforeStart: End month must be the same as or after the start month.
salaries.employerAssignedOnSave: Set automatically after save (periods under « Employers »).
salaries.employerFromPeriodsHelp: The payslip is linked to the first employer with a period covering that month; adjust periods to change it.

auth.signInPageLead: Sign in with Google to access Finance Pilot.
auth.signInUnavailable: Sign-in is unavailable: OAuth or database variables are not configured on this deployment. Contact the administrator.
auth.bannerSynced: Your simulator data is saved to your signed-in account (automatic sync).
auth.bannerBackendDisabled: Server-side saving is not enabled (OAuth or database missing). You can still use the tool, but data will not sync to the cloud.
auth.bannerGuestDescription: You can enter and edit everything freely. To save your scenarios, named projects, and monthly checklist on the server, sign in with Google.

donnees.title: Income, bills, and holdings in one household cash-flow workspace
donnees.description: One screen for household inflows, rentals, and savings inputs—cash available to invest updates as you type. JSON backup stays in the browser; import restores a prior snapshot.

gestionFinances.title: Monthly calendar: due dates, debits, and category split
gestionFinances.description: See what should leave the account each month, mark items paid, and review category shares to catch recurring costs that creep upward.

gestionAnnuelle.title: Annual view: scheduled spend by category and trends
gestionAnnuelle.description: Compare months you captured for a year: totals by category (scheduled fixed charges and annex budgets) and month-by-month curves for the largest categories.

estimations.title: Savings and portfolio curves over 10–30 years
estimations.description: Tune contributions, average return, and horizon—the app plots an indicative capital path. Helps visualize time in market and assumptions, not a promise of returns.

comparaison.title: Compare two plans: draft vs saved projects
comparaison.description: Align metrics, flows, and savings curves to choose which version of your roadmap to keep—handy before a life change or portfolio shift.

salaireSaisie.title: Payslip data and bonuses
salaireSaisie.description: Record gross and net amounts, withholding, meal vouchers; CSV import and categorized bonuses.

salaireRecapitulatif.title: Annual salary summary
salaireRecapitulatif.description: Yearly totals, fixed vs variable, net trends and charts.

salaireEntreprises.title: Employers and tenure
salaireEntreprises.description: Define employers, employment dates, and average pay per company.

savedProjects.autoSaveDraft: Draft: load a project to attach changes to a named snapshot.
savedProjects.draftSessionOnly: Session draft: changes are not stored on the server until you sign in.
savedProjects.loginToSaveHint: Google sign-in is required to create named projects and save them to the database.
savedProjects.oauthNotConfigured: Google OAuth is not configured on the server or client app: cloud save is unavailable for now.

dataPage.title: Data entry
dataPage.subtitle: Enter your income, spending, rental properties, and investments.
dataPage.footer: Use “Projects” to sync data to the server while signed in. JSON export/import below.
dataPage.periodHintPending: Selected month (no data yet): {{label}} — create it below to unlock entry.
dataPage.pendingBodyHidden: Detailed forms, summary cards, and JSON import/export stay hidden until this month is created.
dataPage.missingMonth: No data page for {{label}}. Create this month from scratch or from another month.

dataJson.confirmImport: Replace all on-screen data with this file? Current data will be lost unless you exported it elsewhere.

error.invalid_json: This file is not valid JSON (syntax error).
error.not_object: JSON must be an object { … }, not an array or plain text.
error.unexpected_shape: This JSON does not look like a Finance Pilot backup (expected keys such as revenues, fixed expenses, annex budgets, etc.).

rental.title: Rental properties
rental.maintenanceHintPct: % of rent set aside each month for upkeep
rental.maintenanceHintFixed: Fixed amount set aside for upkeep
rental.otherChargesHint: Fees, agent, accountant, external management, etc. — in euros (monthly or yearly) or as a % of monthly rent received.

investments.title: Investments and savings
investments.placeholder: E.g. stocks & shares ISA, crypto, bond…

estimations.title: Forecasts and projections
estimations.subtitle: See your finances at a glance and project your wealth over time.
estimations.noInvestmentsBody: Add investments on the Data page to see how your portfolio could grow over time.
estimations.footerDisclaimer: Forecasts use the returns you enter; they are not a guarantee of future performance.

comparaison.title: Compare projects
comparaison.subtitle: Pick the draft (by month or by year) and/or saved projects: compare two draft months, two years, or a project against another period. Cards use monthly indicators; the chart shows the investment projection (same approach as Forecasts).
comparaison.alertNoProjectsBody: You can compare the draft to itself to try the screen, or save projects from the “Projects” menu to compare stored scenarios.
comparaison.alertSameBody: Both sides use the same data for the same period. Change a project, month, or year for a meaningful comparison.
comparaison.scenarioADesc: Data used for the first line
comparaison.scenarioBDesc: Data used for the second line
comparaison.yearHintBody: For the draft, the first three cards sum monthly indicators across every month that has a snapshot in the selected year. “Portfolio today” uses the last saved month in that year. The investment projection also starts from that snapshot.
comparaison.projectSnapshotNote: This project has a single saved snapshot; month/year selection applies to the draft only.
comparaison.noDraftMonths: No months saved in the draft yet. Create at least one monthly snapshot on the Data page to compare by month.
comparaison.noDraftYears: No year available yet: save at least one draft month on the Data page first.
comparaison.cardYearSumFootnote: Year view: summed months for the draft; a saved project uses its single snapshot.
comparaison.cardPortfolioYearFootnote: Year view: last draft month in the year, or the project snapshot otherwise.
comparaison.projectionDesc: Estimated value of investment lines (contributions and growth at the rate entered for each line).
comparaison.noInvestmentsBoth: Neither scenario has investments: add investment lines on the Data page to see a projection.
comparaison.gapHint: Positive if scenario A is ahead of B.
comparaison.tableDesc: Portfolio value and gap (A − B) for each year in the horizon.
comparaison.footerDisclaimer: Illustrative projections only: they use the returns you entered and do not predict real markets.

schedule.hint: For monthly tracking: category, mode, and day.
schedule.categoryNoMatch: No saved category matches. Type a name to create it below.
schedule.manual: Manual (transfer or payment you must initiate)
schedule.automatic: Automatic (direct debit on a set day)
schedule.dayOfMonthHint: Optional: leave empty or invalid to default to the 1st when you save.

advancedFinance.title: Monthly cashflow
advancedFinance.subtitle: As of today: manual transfers, upcoming automatic debits, and spend by category (scheduled fixed charges & annex budgets).
advancedFinance.empty: No lines have scheduling turned on. On the Data page, open a fixed charge or annex budget, tick “Enable monthly scheduling”, pick manual vs automatic and the day of month, then save. If you leave category blank, the line label is used.
advancedFinance.upcomingTitle: Automatic debits still due this month
advancedFinance.upcomingDesc: Debits still due this month (including today if it is the due day).
advancedFinance.manualDesc: One row per scheduling category: the amount is the sum of monthly equivalents. “Details” opens the lines in that group (tick “Done” per line). Checkmarks reset at the start of each month.
advancedFinance.detailNoEntity: This line no longer exists in your data.
advancedFinance.resetMonthConfirm: Clear all “done” checkmarks for the budget month shown?
advancedFinance.pastAutoTitle: Automatic debits already taken this month
advancedFinance.monthFromDataHint: The month shown here follows the “budget month” selected on the Data page.

annualPage.title: Annual overview
annualPage.subtitle: Consolidated scheduled spending (fixed charges and annex budgets with a category) for one year: split, totals, and month-by-month trends for the top categories.
annualPage.noMonths: No months saved for this year yet. Add monthly snapshots from the Data page.
annualPage.pieTitle: Split by category ({{year}}, sum of captured months)
annualPage.tableDesc: Sum of monthly equivalents for each month that has data in the year.
annualPage.evolutionDesc: Up to the five highest categories for the year (monthly amount per saved month).
annualPage.tabStripHint: Switch between the full-year view and the quarterly breakdown.
annualPage.quarterlyIntro: For each quarter, amounts sum scheduled spending (fixed charges and annex budgets with scheduling) across months that have a snapshot.
annualPage.quarterEmpty: No months captured in this quarter.
annualPage.quarterCategoryCurveDesc: Each category line sums scheduled monthly amounts across captured months in that quarter. “Disposable balance” sums monthly balance (inflows minus routine outflows, rental, contributions) for those months, consistent with the rest of the app.
annualPage.quarterCurveNothingVisible: Nothing to plot: turn “Disposable balance” back on or select at least one category.
